## Conclusion

1. In this paper, the following research is conducted around order analysis:For the case where a speed signal is available: this thesis establishes a LabVIEW-based rotating machine vibration signal order analysis system to realize the functions of the computational order analysis process (calculation of the arrival time of the rotational speed pulse,calculation of the rotational speed curve by first-order five-point numerical differentiation, determination of the anti-order mixing filter and angular domain resampling rate, etc.). (evidence: document_bce240f3_p0005_00008)
2. In order to verify the effectiveness of the tachometer-free order analysis method proposed in this thesis, a hybrid bus transmission vibration test is designed and the signals of the collected vibration acceleration signals were analyzed, then the results show that the engine speed curve extracted by the FPO algorithm is basically consistent with the engine speed curve measured by the photoelectric tachometer, which reflects that the method has high accuracy and good noise immunity in extracting the instantaneous frequency values of the corresponding order components in the time-frequency diagram and enables the effective realization of the order analysis of rotating machinery vibration signal without tachometer. (evidence: document_bce240f3_p0005_00009)
